mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility is a leading flow indicator: its four-week slide from -40.6 to -50.0 signals suppressed movement that propagates to discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than its mean over the last 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -45.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has risen to 14.3 above baseline, indicating a persistent work-from-home and stay-local behavioral shift; this reduces weekday retail-and-recreation footfall, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than its mean over the last 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above 12.

mechanism_narrative: A WORKPLACES reading at or below -25 signals active or anticipated closure policies that immediately suppress retail-and-recreation demand; crossing this threshold in t-1w and t-0w predicts further RETAIL_REC decline over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than its mean over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains at or below -25.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT is below -45 and RESIDENTIAL is above 12, commuter and leisure traffic is simultaneously drained and displaced to home, creating a reinforcing stay-local interaction that drives RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT < -45 and RESIDENTIAL > 12, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is equal to or higher than its mean over the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a broad tightening regime where TRANSIT is at or below -45 and WORKPLACES is at or below -25, restrictions are wide enough to sustain retail-and-recreation suppression for four weeks rather than produce a quick rebound.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than its mean over the last 28 days while both TRANSIT <= -45 and WORKPLACES <= -25 hold.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS volatility from +29.7 to -2.6 shows unfavorable outdoor conditions; when PARKS remains below +5, outdoor recreation does not offset lost indoor retail trips, so RETAIL_REC stays lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than its mean over the last 28 days while PARKS remains below +5.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM stability near -8 while RETAIL_REC is much lower indicates households are consolidating trips around essentials; continued grocery-only trip patterns will keep discretionary retail depressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than its mean over the last 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains between -10 and -5.

mechanism_narrative: Four consecutive weeks of steep RETAIL_REC declines to -46.1 and TRANSIT to -50.0 indicate an overshoot; as restrictions stabilize, pent-up demand produces a higher RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT <= -50.0.
